violation_type.typical_finding: The Director has not completed 30 annual training hours.

finding_variants.text: The Director has not completed 30 annual training hours.

Recite: The Director did not have the required annual trainings for the training period, 6/18/20- 6/18/21.     The following training topics were missing:   -6 hours in one or more of the following topics:   (1)Child growth and development, (2)Guidance and discipline, (3)Age-appropriate curriculum [Medium]; and (4)Teacher-child interaction.     -child maltreatment  -SIDS, shaken baby syndrome, childhood brain development     -(1)Emergency preparedness   (2)Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations   (3)Administering medication   (4)Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction   (5)Understanding building and physical premises safety   (6)Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials     --3 hours Management
The director does not have annual 30 hours of training.
